Gary Christian brings 37 years of public service and leadership experience to his campaign to serve Thunder Bay. Since 2022, he has served as Executive Director of the North Superior Workforce Planning Board, working with employers, educators, and governments to strengthen the local economy and create opportunities. Before joining the Board, Gary spent 34 years with the Ontario Ministry of Labour, Immigration, Training and Skills Development as a Community Development Officer in Thunder Bay, partnering with municipalities, businesses, Indigenous communities, and governments on practical local solutions. Gary also served 17 years with the Royal Canadian Navy, shaping the leadership, teamwork, and accountability he brings to public service. He currently serves as a Trustee with the Lakehead District School Board and holds an MBA and two degrees in political science/law from Lakehead University. In 2021, he received the City of Thunder Bay's Citizen of Exceptional Achievement Award for his community service. Gary believes Thunder Bay can be stronger, safer, and more prosperous. His priorities are safer streets, tackling homelessness, better roads, responsible spending, and economic growth. He’ll bring a practical, accountable, results-focused approach to City Hall — listening, leading, and delivering for Thunder Bay.
